name: Burning Chilli X

features.name: Wild substitution
features.description: Wilds substitute for all symbols except scatters.

review:
Burning Chilli X is a fiery classic slot whose main feature is a choice of 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 lines, selected with buttons on screen. Traditional wilds and scatters provide the extras.

The wild substitutes for every symbol except the scatter. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility, which, together with the variable lines, should mean frequent payouts. The maximum multiplier is 3,000x. The headline figure is the 97.16% RTP, one of the highest in this database. It's essentially the same design as Wild Tiger, so choose based on whether you prefer chillies or tigers.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
